segments.rationale: Cold-open hook — the sharpest late-episode passage (src 300.0-300.8) dropped first so the clip reads in under one second; punch-in at 0.80 is the only near-max move of the edit. Signal: hook moment, medium-motion b-roll per analysis, cut grid set to dialogue cadence since no beatTimestamps were returned (conf 0.50).

Same continuous passage held (300.8-303.8) so the hook line is never cut mid-sentence — the 0.8s picture punch-in is picture-only, audio runs straight through. slow-push 0.30 keeps a talking-head frame alive across the 3.0s statement. Signal: hook payoff, second of the two shots inside the first 2s.

Chapter A premise (src 24.0-27.6) — the chronological spine starts here once the cold open has hooked. handheld at 0.25 adds presence without disturbing the speaker. Signal: chapter change out of the hook, carried by the 0.35s dipToBlack.

Continuation of the same sentence block (27.6-30.6), punched in at 0.35 for emphasis on the turn of the premise; audio is continuous with the previous shot so nothing is cut mid-sentence. Signal: cadence boundary inside the chapter A run.

Phase-1 hold (30.6-34.4, 3.8s) — the longest shot of the opening third, drift-left 0.30 gives the stable frame lateral life and settles well before the cut. Signal: sets the 2.84s phase-1 average that phases 2 and 3 must beat; exits on the crossfade chapter change.

Chapter B opens (src 150.0-152.2) on the 0.40s crossfade; punch-in 0.45 marks the treatment change and starts the denser grid. Signal: chapter change, first shot of the 1.98s phase-2 average (69% of phase 1).

Tighter continuation of the same run (152.2-153.9), handheld 0.30 — drops the shot length from 2.2s to 1.7s so the rhythm starts accelerating. Signal: cadence boundary, audio continuous with the previous shot.

Argument develops (153.9-156.1), slow-push 0.30 across a 2.2s beat — the small lengthening stops phase 2 from flattening into a metronome. Signal: mid-chapter cadence boundary in the continuous B run.
Lateral change within the same run (156.1-157.6); drift-right 0.35 mirrors the phase-1 drift-left so neighbours never repeat. Signal: 1.5s cut on cadence, pattern interrupt inside the 2-4s window.

Phase-2 contrast hold (157.6-160.3, 2.7s) with breathe 0.30 — the one place the middle third stops pushing, so the pivot after it lands. Signal: the lightLeak treatment turn fires at this shot's end (24.50).
Pivot beat (160.3-161.8) entered on the 0.30s lightLeak; tilt-up 0.30 lifts the frame into the second half of the chapter. Signal: chapter/treatment change at 24.50, 1.5s keeps phase 2 tightening.
Last clean statement of chapter B (161.8-164.2, 2.4s), punch-in 0.40 — the setup beat that the ramp immediately answers. Signal: cadence boundary 2.4s before the ramp trigger.

The edit's single speed ramp (src 164.2-165.35, 1.15s of source stretched to ~1.5s): 1.0 -> 0.55 -> 1.0, ramping into the peak, holding slow through it, ramping out, pitch-corrected so the voice never droops. Placed last in chapter B so the stretch cannot push the following run out of lip-sync — the whipPan at 29.90 resets it. Signal: chapter change into the payoff plus the ramp peak itself; tonal lift rides the entry.

Payoff chapter opens (src 340.0-341.3) on the whipPan release; whip-shake 0.45 plus the light-leak signature mark the biggest structural turn of the edit. Signal: chapter change at 29.90 — phase 3 drops to a 1.37s average, 48% of phase 1.

Tightest continuation of the payoff run (341.3-342.4), punch-in 0.45 — first of the sub-1.3s cuts that make the final third visibly denser; audio continuous so the sentence is never broken. Signal: cadence boundary inside the chapter C run.
Same continuous passage (342.4-343.6) on handheld 0.30 — energy without a zoom, and a move that differs from both neighbours. Signal: 1.2s cut on cadence.
Shortest beat of the run so far (343.6-344.6, 1.0s), slow-push 0.35 — a pattern interrupt well inside the 2-4s window. Signal: cadence boundary at the densest point of phase 3.
Lateral answer to the whip-shake (344.6-345.8), drift-left 0.35 — varies direction so the montage does not read as one repeated punch. Signal: 1.2s cut on cadence.

Impact cut (345.8-346.8, 1.0s) with punch-in 0.50 and a 0.4s grain pulse landed exactly on the cut — phase-3 hit, escalated to 0.70 intensity from the 0.60 hook flash. Signal: the 35.70 cut in the continuous payoff run.
Downbeat (346.8-348.0), tilt-down 0.30 — the frame drops as the callout 'the moment it lands' rises 0.3s in and carries deliberately across the next cut. Signal: cadence boundary at 36.70.
Breath (348.0-349.0, 1.0s) with breathe 0.30 — keeps a short, potentially static frame alive at the tightest point of the grid and settles back to base before the cut. Signal: cadence boundary.

Second whip-shake of the edit (349.0-350.1) at 0.40 — re-energises 1.1s before the pre-landing punch; deliberately carries no effect so the move alone does the work. Signal: cadence boundary at 38.90.

Pre-landing punch (350.1-351.1, 1.0s) — punch-in 0.55 plus a 0.3s brightness dip (value -8, intensity 0.80) landed on the 41.00 cut, the strongest hit of the edit, so the hold that follows feels earned. Signal: the final cut before the landing.

Landing hold (351.1-355.1, 4.0s) — pull-back 0.35 eases out to the wide frame and settles, the longest shot of the edit, with the 'PODCAST #1' card settling 0.3s in. Signal: payoff resolution; ends the timeline exactly at 45.0 with the dialogue allowed to finish rather than being chopped.

textElements.rationale: Hook title card, deliberately held until 2.4s so both hook shots (0.0-0.8 and 0.8-3.8) land before any type — the image hooks first. Override to 76pt in the upper safe band: out of the top 10% UI zone, clear of the speaker's face, and scaled above the caption template for hierarchy. zoom-blur matches the punch-in energy. Ends 3.70, just before the 3.80 dipToBlack.

Chapter marker for the spine's first act, 0.3s after shot 2 begins (3.80) per the entry offset rule; 3 words over 2.8s clears the 1.0s reading floor and ends 6.90, before the 7.40 cut. slide-left is animation preset 2.
Chapter marker fired 0.3s after chapter B opens at 14.20; typewriter (preset 3) gives the middle third a different texture from the setup card. Ends 16.30, just inside the 16.40 cut.

Quiet instruction to the viewer placed 0.3s into the 2.7s phase-2 hold (21.80) — the one beat where the cut grid relaxes, so the line has room. Raised to y 0.62 to sit below the face region and above the lower-third band. Ends 24.10, before the 24.50 lightLeak.

Final chapter marker, 0.3s after the payoff chapter opens at 29.90. pop (preset 4) is the loudest of the three markers, matching the escalated treatment. The 1.3s shot cannot hold 3 words, so the card deliberately carries across the 31.20 cut into shot 14.

Callout 0.3s into the tilt-down beat (36.70); 4 words over 2.6s clears the 1.33s reading floor. rise (preset 5) plays against the tilt-down move. Deliberately spans the 38.90 cut so the line survives the densest part of the grid.

Landing card, 0.3s into the 4.0s pull-back hold (41.00) so the frame settles first and the title is the last thing read; slow 0.6s fade-in against the fastest cut grid of the edit. Override to 68pt in the upper band, mirroring the hook card to close the loop. Ends 44.70, inside the 45.0 timeline.

transitions.rationale: Chapter change: the cold open (src 300s) resolves to black before the chronological spine begins at src 24.0, so the time jump reads as authored rather than as a broken cut. 0.35s, first of four, no two consecutive types alike.
Chapter change A -> B at 14.20: a 0.40s crossfade softens the jump from src 34.4 to src 150.0 and marks the shift into the denser phase-2 grid. Different type from the preceding dipToBlack.
Treatment change at the phase-2 pivot (24.50): a 0.30s warm leak breaks the run mid-chapter, the pattern interrupt that separates the hold from the drive to the ramp. Third distinct type in a row.

Chapter change B -> payoff at 29.90: a 0.30s whipPan fires on the ramp's release, converting the slow-mo exit into forward momentum straight onto the whip-shake. No glitch used — the footage is calm, face-led podcast material.

audioDecisions.rationale: No audio file was uploaded, so the podcast's own track is the bed. Bed 1 is phase-aligned to the hook run (src 300.0-303.8 under timeline 0.0-3.8) so the cold-open line plays complete and in sync.
Bed 2 carries chapter A continuously (src 24.0-34.4 under 3.8-14.2). One unbroken audio pass across four picture punch-cuts — the dialogue is never cut mid-sentence, only the frame is.
Bed 3 carries chapter B continuously (src 150.0-164.2 under 14.2-28.4) across seven picture cuts, keeping the argument legible while the visual grid tightens.

Bed 4 covers the ramp shot at reduced volume: the voice stays at natural tempo while the frame stretches, the standard podcast slow-mo device, and it closes the 1.5s gap so music spans the whole edit.
Bed 5 carries the payoff chapter to the end (src 340.0-355.1 under 29.9-45.0), phase-aligned across ten picture cuts and allowed to finish its sentence under the 4.0s landing hold.
One-shot impact lifted from the source's own transient at 164.2 and doubled under the ramp entry at 28.40 — the biggest structural hit before the payoff chapter. Timed exactly to the cut.
One-shot impact on the 41.00 cut into the landing hold, paired with the brightness dip so the final turn is felt as well as seen. Timed exactly to the cut.

captionTemplate.rationale: Single template inherited by all seven elements: white Inter, lower-third safe band (y 0.74 keeps type out of the bottom 20% UI zone and clear of the speaker's face region in a 9:16 podcast frame). Overrides are declared per element where the hierarchy needs a different scale or band.

metadata.rationale: Single 416.4s podcast source, one analyzed segment (b-roll, medium motion, conf 0.50) with no beat timestamps, motion peaks or face metrics returned. Built as an authored trailer: cold-open hook lifted from the late-episode payoff region (src 300.0), then a chronological three-chapter spine (A: 24-34s, B: 150-165s, C: 340-355s) that lands back in the payoff region for the hold. Every chapter is cut from ONE continuous source run so the speaker is never cut mid-sentence — the picture punch-cuts while the dialogue audio stays continuous. Rhythm map: phase 1 avg 2.84s (5 shots), phase 2 avg 1.98s = 69% (8 shots), phase 3 avg 1.37s = 48% (11 shots) with a 4.0s pull-back landing, the longest shot of the edit. Cut grid follows the source dialogue cadence (the only rhythmic signal available); no music grid exists because no audio file was uploaded, so the podcast's own audio is the bed and is phase-aligned to each picture run. Treatment is face-safe throughout: one coherent grade, no glitch / aberration / blur on any shot.
